whole_comparison.scope: One allocation; official full-three-kernel hosts only. Diagnostic timings are not promotion measurements.

major_research.basis: Early scalar ready but quant DMA/VRF delayed; same-clock observed interval37,235; existing first-term advance is lost before native after late packed/seed/ring. DirectVRF removes this dependency without assuming its span becomes whole gain.

limits: One allocation with three original inputs and two clusters per trace; six observations are not six independent allocations.
Endpoint median differences are not paired per-run deltas across the two serial stages. Within-side interval metrics use endpoints from the same run/cluster clock.
Both current E151 and E153 internal traces are observed; historical E150 is not used as the control.
Spans include waits and overlap; no durations are summed as service, bus stalls, or obtainable speedup.
Advancing one producer need not advance whole completion because resource scheduling and overlap can change.
This names-only diagnostic is not an additional adoption performance allocation.
